- Thesis: The most interesting problems are rarely about making people or machines more intelligent, or even faster. They're about designing systems that maximize existing intelligence.

## What he works on
- Co-founder of managent (Slack for AI agents; 5 design partners, 200+ engineers)
- Co-founder of Origin Student Founders (immigrant entrepreneurship bootcamp + learning platform)
- GTM / partnerships experience at DevRev
- Forward deployed engineering at HaiIntel (hospital AI workflows)
- Research: accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 VeriCodeGen workshop (the work behind managent), an ACM ICAIF workshop, and ACM WoAIS ’26. Ongoing work at MIT LIDS.
